name: Tiny Circuits
detailed_description:
Tinker with Tiny Tech!

In Tiny Circuits, you play as a miniature robot navigating compact, grid-based circuit boards to restore power and complete electrical puzzles. It’s a bite-sized logic challenge with a unique twist: while each level is hand-designed, the puzzle layouts are randomized—making every playthrough feel fresh and challenging.

Your goal is simple: connect the power source to the endpoint by placing and rotating circuit components like wires and logic gates.

Key Features

  • Handcrafted levels with randomized component layouts

  • Simple controls, intuitive gameplay, and growing challenge curve

  • Clean, colorful visuals designed for quick readability and mobile feel

  • Built-in replayability with procedurally shuffled puzzle pieces

Whether you’re a puzzle fan or a tech tinkerer, Tiny Circuits offers a compact brain-teasing experience perfect for short sessions or deeper marathons.

Tiny package. Clever circuits. Big challenge.

short_description: Solve bite-sized circuit board puzzles as a tiny robot! Connect components, become employee of the month in this logic puzzler with randomized layouts and handcrafted charm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.5 GHz) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or Radeon Vega 3
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (3.0 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5770 or equivalent with at least 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel i5 (2015 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU or Intel Iris 6100
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel i5 (2015 or newer)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or Intel Iris Pro
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: macOS-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended
